title: People’s Mañanera October 20
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Women’s Health Is a Priority  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum announced the opening of 32 cancer centers—one
per state—offering comprehensive, free care. The La Pastora model, which has
already saved hundreds of lives, will allow patients to begin treatment in
less than 30 days.

**Chihuahua: Justice Takes Precedence Over Politics  
** The President rejected any agreements in the case involving the former
Chihuahua attorney general. The Federal Attorney General’s Office (FGR) is
investigating the involvement of unauthorized U.S. agents in an operation and
reiterated that guilt or innocence is determined by evidence.

**Water for Jalisco: Solutions for Unfinished Projects  
** The Mexican government and the National Water Commission (Conagua) are
working to ensure clean and sufficient water in Guadalajara. Sheinbaum noted
that the previous Jalisco administration left projects unfinished and
announced that alternatives and financing options are being reviewed.

**Housing for Well-Being: A Right, Not a Privilege  
** Sheinbaum emphasized that the 4T will guarantee access to decent housing
for 12 million families—nearly 43 million Mexicans. The goal includes new
housing, home improvements, and property titles.
